Part 2 When powers of Stop and Search may be used

3. Applicability of this Code

3.1 This Code applies to:
(a) all stops and searches of a person who is not in police custody carried out
pursuant to a statutory power (see Annex A for a non-exhaustive list)
and
(b) searches of a person carried out in accordance with a search warrant issued
by a court in Scotland

3.2 This Code does not apply to:
• Searches of persons in custody
• Searches of persons under arrest
• Searches of vehicles and vessels that do not also involve a search of a
 person
